label: Interrogated Western regimes of truth from Māori epistemic sovereignty
description: Engaging post-structural critiques of power/knowledge, Smith showed that Western research itself remains an imperial technology unless governed by Kaupapa Māori ethics.
dialecticalTension: Replaces Eurocentric critique of power with Indigenous methodological self-determination.

label: Systematized critique of colonial anthropology into Kaupapa Māori methodology
description: Building on Deloria’s indictment of extractive academic research, Smith developed a comprehensive international philosophy of Indigenous research sovereignty.
dialecticalTension: Transforms anti-anthropological critique into positive Indigenous philosophy of science.

label: Founded Decolonizing Methodologies paradigm
description: Smith codified 25 Indigenous research practices—claiming, storytelling, indigenizing, reframing—that treat research as ethical kinship with colonized communities.
dialecticalTension: Redefines objectivity around relational accountability rather than colonial detachment.

label: Provided methodological blueprint for TallBear’s Indigenous STS critique
description: Kim TallBear directly draws on Smith’s Decolonizing Methodologies to study settler genetic science "from standing with" Indigenous communities.
dialecticalTension: Bridges Kaupapa Māori epistemology and North American Indigenous STS.

label: Informed Nishnaabeg epistemic resurgence and community-grounded inquiry
description: Simpson extends Smith’s call to center Indigenous intelligence systems outside colonial academic extraction.
dialecticalTension: Connects Māori methodological sovereignty with Nishnaabeg grounded normativity.
